title: Critical operation with an explicitly granted human confirmation, under a stricter compliance config
mechanism: critical_operation is true and a HumanConfirmation with confirmed=true is registered for the same scope, so I-20 holds. The ambient config is stricter than the default (bias detection and explainability required) purely to show the config patch surface is exercised; the state is safe-by-construction under that config, so no invariant fires.
rationale: Negative control for I-20. It guards the false positive where a critical operation is treated as a violation regardless of the confirmation record. Together with issue-38687 (same flag, no confirmation -> violation) and the crate-level denial case, it pins the predicate to 'confirmed record present' rather than 'critical operation flagged'. Note that `confirmed: false` would NOT satisfy this gate; that variant is covered by the test `i20_denied_confirmation_does_not_satisfy_the_gate`.

metadata.config_regime: bias detection + explainability required (stricter than default)
